name: agent-webpage
title: Agent Webpage
description: Talk to the live webpage client for an agent on this host. Run JS, ping, send custom events and await the real reply over the chat WebSocket.
author: cicy-ai

zh-CN.title: Agent Webpage
zh-CN.description: 通过聊天 WebSocket 与 agent 当前页面客户端通信，执行 JS、ping、发送自定义事件并等待实际响应。

tools.name: ping
tools.description: Check if the webpage client is alive
tools.prompt: 运行 agent-webpage ping 检查网页客户端状态

tools.name: eval
tools.description: Run JavaScript in the live agent webpage
tools.prompt: 帮我用 agent-webpage eval 在网页中执行 JS，请告诉我代码

tools.name: send-event
tools.description: Send a custom event to the webpage and await the reply
tools.prompt: 帮我用 agent-webpage send-event 发送自定义事件
